text: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of three Council Members to fill vacancies on the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority Board of Directors.

City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council reappoint Councillor Parthi Kandavel to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority Board of Directors for a term of office until November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
